title: insufficient_fund_share — small-volume error-share signal for the funds wave
hypothesis: customer_insufficient_funds_wave is missed because its night buckets carry 1-5 events (under min_bucket_count) and every 12h pass except one starts inside the 20h wave (baseline poisoning). The insufficient-fund SHARE of failures is visible in the sparse regime: the mix moves (measured ~0.21 baseline to 0.5-0.88) even when the success rate is unreadable.

dataset.ground_truth: customer_insufficient_funds_wave 2026-08-16T18:30Z .. 08-17T14:30Z (00:00-20:00 IST), fail_boost +0.30 on card/upi with 90% forced insufficient_fund, affected INR 104,458 (recoverable=True)

metric_definition.name: insufficient_fund_share
metric_definition.bucket_value: insufficient-fund failures / all failed terminal outcomes in the bucket (defensive substring match on error_reason)
metric_definition.bucket_grid: 60 min (12x the 5-min request grid) — measured necessary: 30-min night buckets hold 0-3 failures and cannot form scored runs
metric_definition.floors: min_bucket_count 2 failures (metric default), min_flagged_volume 3 failures (metric default), min_flagged_run 1 (metric default), min_absolute_deviation 0.25, min_observed 0.90, z >= 3, baseline_buckets 8 (global default)
metric_definition.why_min_observed_0.9: measured organic daytime IF clusters reach 0.71 share on 7 failures (z up to 7) — statistically STRONGER than the wave's night bucket (f=3, share 1.0, z 3.2); only a near-single-class hour separates them on this dataset

candidate_history: v1 (run 1, vol 3, abs 0.25, no min_observed): wave caught, but 5 organic FPs on standard-42 (shares 0.28-0.45), P 0.348 overall
v2 (+ min_observed 0.6): wave caught, 2 organic FPs remain (shares 0.71), P 0.636 — below the 0.65 gate
v3 (4-bucket baseline + run 2): organic FPs killed but wave LOST (only one night bucket reaches z >= 3; no 2-bucket run exists) — R 0.833
C2 FINAL (run 1 + min_observed 0.9): wave caught, 0 organic FPs on standard-42/quiet-42/standard-7, P 0.778 overall

selection: C2 selected on standard-42 + quiet-42 (precision gate >= 0.65, zero new FPs); validated on standard-7 (wave caught, no IF-share FPs) and payday_wave_demo (wave MISSED — scale limitation, no FP; kept because it costs no precision and catches the standard-scale wave)
